thread:
lena-support: Customer Orbitix reports invoice INV-19842 posted without their purchase ref PO-5567. Payment cleared yesterday. They need the invoice reissued with the PO for their internal reconciliation. Receipt attached: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/INV-19842/receipt.pdf

devin-finance: assigning to billing queue. Do we need a credit+rebill or can we just append the PO to the existing invoice? @sophie-billing

sophie-billing: Because status = paid we cannot modify the original invoice record. Standard process is credit + rebill:
- Issue full credit memo to reverse INV-19842
- Create new invoice INV-19842-R1 with purchase_order = PO-5567
- Reapply or reallocate payment to the new invoice (collections step)
I'll start the credit now and follow up with collections. ETA ~ 2 business days unless collections can reallocate the payment same day.

lena-support: customer needs this by EOD tomorrow for an audit. Any way to accelerate? They said an emailed invoice PDF with PO would suffice for now.

sophie-billing: If collections can reallocate payment PAY-9911 today, we can expedite. Need finance approval for a same-day reallocation exception. Devin, can you sign off on GL exception? Also flagging tax/VAT — invoice shows VAT=0, confirm that's expected.

devin-finance: I can approve provisional reallocation for Orbitix. GL code 4002. Please include a note referencing VAT check.

sophie-billing: Quick repro/debug via billing API to confirm current values:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_KEY" "https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-19842" | jq '.purchase_order, .status, .tax.vat'
# output: null "paid" 0
```
I'll create credit memo CM-2301 and new invoice INV-19842-R1 with PO=PO-5567 and VAT=0, then request collections to reapply PAY-9911 to the new invoice. CM created and queued for approval.

billing-bot: CM-2301 created by sophie-billing for INV-19842 (https://billing.redwood.ai/credits/CM-2301)

collections-team: can the team reallocate PAY-9911 to INV-19842-R1 today if finance signs off? Please DM collections-team with payment ID and new invoice link.

lena-support: I told the customer we'll try for a same-day reallocation and offered to email the reissued PDF as interim evidence. They're ok with that for the audit.

devin-finance: finance approval recorded. GL 4002, approver devin-finance, noted at 1867890450.

sophie-billing: Following up with collections now. Will update this thread when payment reallocation completes and when the customer-facing PDF is sent. Thanks :thumbsup:
